age_limit.age_details: Apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act, 1961, for one year duration

how_to_apply: POWERGRID has outlined a two-step application process for this recruitment:
Candidates who possess the required educational qualification must first register themselves on the NATS (National Apprenticeship Training Scheme) portal at nats.education.gov.in.

After registration on the NATS portal, eligible candidates must submit an online application through the POWERGRID website, www.powergrid.in, by going to the Careers section and selecting Engagement of Apprentices.

Before applying, candidates should view the detailed advertisement issued by the relevant region or establishment of POWERGRID regarding state-wise and trade-wise training slots, and then submit the application based on their choice of state and trade, along with all required documents.

content_sections.text: POWERGRID has outlined a two-step application process for this recruitment: Candidates who possess the required educational qualification must first register themselves on the NATS (National Apprenticeship Training Scheme) portal at nats.education.gov.in. After registration on the NATS portal, eligible candidates must submit an online application through the POWERGRID website, www.powergrid.in, by going to the Careers section and selecting Engagement of Apprentices.

faq.question: Q1. What is the POWERGRID Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 advertisement number?
Q2. What is the duration of the POWERGRID apprenticeship?
faq.answer: The apprenticeship is for different trades and is for a duration of one year, under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for POWERGRID Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The online application closing date is 10.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for POWERGRID Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Candidates must first register on the NATS portal (nats.education.gov.in) and then submit an online application through the Careers section of www.powergrid.in.

faq.question: Q5. I have already registered on the NATS portal. Do I still need to apply on the POWERGRID website?
faq.answer: Yes. POWERGRID has specified that candidates who registered on the NATS Apprenticeship Portal must also submit their application through the POWERGRID website, as only applications submitted there will be considered for engagement.

faq.question: Q6. Will I get a job at POWERGRID after completing the apprenticeship?
faq.answer: No. POWERGRID has clarified that on completion of the apprenticeship training, the apprentice will have no claim whatsoever for employment in the organisation.
